dt-example.title: List view
dt-example.info:
The second interface for StateRestore makes use of a dropdown button (`-button collection`) to show a list of the states that are available, allowing them to be quickly restored and provides sub-buttons for editing control of states. This example demonstrates that with the `-button statesList` button.
Furthermore, to create a new state, in this case `-button stateCreate` is provided to the end user, providing a simple way for a new state to be quickly created based on the table's state when the button is clicked.
Next: [Combining buttons](./listView-singleButton.html).
